2-Substituted Benzimidazoles have been synthesized in good to high yields by the one-pot reaction between o-phenylenediamine and aldehydes in the presence of anhydrous iron phosphate as a catalyst.

Anhydrous ferric phosphate (FePO4) has been employed as an efficient and recyclable catalyst for one-pot synthesis of various 2-substitued benzimidazoles from the reaction of o-phenylenediamine, aldehydes and ammonium acetate in ethanol at room temperature.
